title: Near-One Success for the Grover–Simon Attack
summary: The attack is proved to succeed with probability at least two-fifths; proving success close to one from n plus a constant Simon samples remains open.

formal_statement.body: Establish that $n+O(1)$ values $u_i$ span $U$ in the periodic case and have rank $n$ in the non-periodic case with probability close to $1$, yielding attack success close to $1$.

scope.domain: Quantum symmetric-key cryptanalysis of the FX construction via the Grover–Simon attack.
parameters: n: dimension parameter controlling the sample count and the full-rank target
u_i: sampled Simon vectors whose span or rank controls classification
U: subspace to be spanned in the periodic case
scope.unresolved_remainder: Prove that n plus a constant sampled vectors span U in the periodic case and have rank n in the non-periodic case with probability close to one, thereby establishing near-one attack success.

citations.label: Grover Meets Simon - Quantumly Attacking the FX-construction

progress.summary: The source proves attack success with probability at least two-fifths, then presents near-one success from n plus a constant samples as an expected improvement. The required spanning and rank behavior remains unproved.
citation_labels: Gregor Leander et al., Grover Meets Simon - Quantumly Attacking the FX-construction
